title: Devesh Chaturvedi, Pushpendra Kumar Garg Assume Office as NSB Chairperson, Member
body_text: New Delhi, November 16, 2026: The National Sports Board’s (NSB) new leadership team assumed office on November 16, 2026, in New Delhi. Shri Devesh Chaturvedi, IAS (Retd.), assumed his role as the NSB Chairperson, while Commodore (Retd.) Pushpendra Kumar Garg joined as an NSB Member. The appointment of the NSB Chairperson and Member has been approved by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC). Established under the National Sports Governance Act, 2025, and operationalized through the National Sports Governance (National Sports Board) Rules, 2026, the National Sports Board serves as India’s apex central authority for granting recognition to National Sports Bodies and ensuring their adherence to governance, financial, and ethical standards. ****** Ayushman Kumar

ministry.name: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
